title: a Bash write around the artifact door is named right after it runs
intention: A Bash command that writes a record of truth around the artifact door is named to CC right after it runs, whatever shape the write took: artifactgate's PostToolUse pass lists the changed records whose working bytes the journal never saw.
why: Measured 2026-11-18 on ticket b7068b1ba431: artifactgate's PreToolUse verdict reads only the command text, so `python3 <scratch>/w.py`, whose body writes a ticket, is allowed (exit 0); the first thing that sees the write is cairn artifact check at commit, after the edit is made, when the way through is a park. The record moves with no journal line for the whole gap.
traces_to: Law 4: a rule that matters is enforced by physics; Law 7: errors are loud at diagnostic surfaces.
how: bin/cmd/artifactgate reads hook_event_name from stdin. On PostToolUse for Bash it asks, per root in door.roots(), git status --porcelain for changed paths, keeps those door.locate() names a record, and names each whose working-copy sha is not door.last_sha(door.read_journal(root), rel); exit 2 with the way through (cairn artifact hand-edit <path> --why). Nothing named, exit 0. PreToolUse is unchanged. .claude/settings.json registers artifactgate under PostToolUse, matcher Bash. The proof points the door at a scratch tree with door.set_diagnostic_roots.

measured.saw: artifactgate allows `python3 <scratch>/w.py` (exit 0) and refuses `cat x > <ticket>` and `python3 -c 'open(<ticket>,"w")'` (exit 2)
measured.how: piping the three hook payloads into bin/cmd/artifactgate on akiendelllinux

constraints: the after-run pass lives in bin/cmd/artifactgate beside verdict(), and asks the door (locate, read_journal, last_sha) rather than a second spelling of the record set
PreToolUse behaviour is unchanged; the PostToolUse pass never writes, it only names
the proof drives the hook through its stdin contract against a scratch root set by door.set_diagnostic_roots, one tooth per outcome

outcomes.claim: a Bash command running a script file that writes a scratch-root ticket is allowed by PreToolUse and, after it runs, named by PostToolUse with exit 2 and the record path in stderr
the same ticket written through artifact.write is not named after the command

.claude/settings.json registers bin/cmd/artifactgate under PostToolUse with matcher Bash
